name: Muro-Akame-Aoyama Quasi-National Park
nameJa: 室生赤目青山国定公園
aliases: 室生赤目青山国定公園
description: Quasi-national park of the Muro, Akame and Aoyama mountains in Mie and Nara, home to the Akame 48 waterfalls and the Muro-ji temple forest.
notes: Managed by Mie/Nara. The Akame falls trail and Muro-ji are the highlights.
parking: Parking available at major visitor areas (fee varies)
